pageProps.title: Danke Olle Noodles
pageProps.review: Check out the honest review of thick Bomal Kalghuksu and Bomal Porridge tasted at Danke Olle Noodles, a famous restaurant in Pyoseon, Seogwipo, Jeju, including Catch Table waiting tips and taste evaluations for each menu.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Bomal Kalghuksu (Top Shell Noodle Soup)", "rating": 4 } --- Noodle and rice are served together in a slightly thick broth. ``` ```menu { "title": "Bomal-juk (Top Shell Porridge)", "rating": 3.5 } --- The broth feels a bit different from Bomal Kalghuksu. It might feel a bit greasy if you eat a lot. ``` ## Review Since there is a wait, Catch Table is a must! However, the turnover rate was good, so I didn't wait long.
